buyer_portal.description: Beautiful end-unit townhome-style condo built in 2025 in the heart of downtown Vienna. Three bedrooms, three and a half baths and 2,850 square feet, with high ceilings and a private elevator offering the option for aging in place. The main level features a gourmet kitchen opening to light-filled living and dining spaces and a four-season room overlooking the surrounding foliage. The spacious owner’s suite has a walk-in closet and spa-inspired bath, joined by an additional en suite bedroom and a flexible den. The lower level offers a third bedroom, full bath, storage and the attached two-car garage. A private setting, a short walk from Vienna’s shops, restaurants, parks, Church Street and Town Green events.
